ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Work` and its initial state `Step1`.

`go to Done` has no trigger, so it leaves `Work` in the first tick after it was entered. Because it is a weak abort, `Step1` still takes its own transition to `Step2` in this tick first; then `Work` is left. KIELER warns because a trigger-less abort out of a superstate is usually a mistake (`join to` waits for the inside to finish).
